integrity_statement: The mathematical argument uses finite-group Fourier convergence and exact digit-block independence. Numerical tests are finite corroboration only; prior equivalences may remain unindexed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed prime powers only; no global gcd density, no independence between primes, and no growing-modulus uniform estimate. Some individual local factors occur in prior squarefree-reversal literature.
title: Complete prime-power congruence law for digit reversal
